name: com.blacksprinters/booking
title: BlackSprinters.com
description: Group transport in 60 cities: Jet Sprinters, party buses, limousines and coaches, with from-prices.

tools.name: search_coverage
tools.description: Find BlackSprinters.com pages for a city, vehicle, occasion (party, wedding, prom, concert, corporate), airport/FBO/cruise transfer, road trip or travel guide. Returns titles, summaries and URLs (with Markdown versions).

query.description: e.g. "Las Vegas party bus", "Jet Sprinter", "Miami cruise port", "wedding"

section.description: Optional first path segment filter, e.g. fleet, cities, party-bus, wedding-transportation, private-jet-fbo, blog

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Return the Markdown text of a BlackSprinters.com page. Accepts a full URL or a path such as /fleet/jet-sprinter/.

tools.name: get_booking_options
tools.description: Vehicles with seats, bags and from prices, services, the 5-hour minimum, overtime rule, booker link, WhatsApp dispatch and booking policies.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Send a chauffeured group-vehicle request to BlackSprinters.com dispatch for the traveller. Only call when the traveller explicitly asked to book. Returns a reference (BS-XXXXXXX); dispatch then confirms vehicle, exact price and operator. It is not a confirmed booking until then, and nothing is charged.

name.description: Lead passenger or organiser full name

pickup.description: Full address, airport + terminal, FBO, hotel or cruise terminal

dropoff.description: Destination for a transfer (or use hours)

flight.description: Flight, tail number or ship name

enum: 30 Pax Party Bus Min by hr
First Class Mercedes S Class / equivalent
6 Pax Premier Luxury SUV Lincoln or equivalent

notes.description: Occasion, stops, child seats, accessibility, sign name, privacy, etc.

agent.description: Name of your assistant or app

consent.description: The traveller explicitly asked for this booking
